THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the land described below is neededfor a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions ofthat Act.

An allotment of land depicted in the Advance Tracing No. CO/DSO/2015/752 and dated 23.11.2015, prepared by the Surveyor-General, situated in the Village of Narahenpita in the Grama NiladhariDivision of Gothamipura in the Divisional Secretary’s Division ofThimbirigasyaya of Colombo District in Western Province andbounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Assmt. No. 151/3, Sri Jayawardanapura Mawatha– Extent: 0.0347 HectareNorth: Land of which Assmt. No. is not found; East: Land ofwhich Assmt. No. is not found and land bearing Assmt. No. 155/2;South: Lands bearing Assmt. Nos. 155/2 and 151/3; West: Landbearing Assmt. No. 151/3, Road and land of which Assmt. No. is notfound.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
My Ref. No.: 4-3/12/2014/UDA/356.Ministry of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms,“Mihikatha Medura”,Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla.25th September, 2018.
